resources.string: Reads on-screen text while TikTok is open to detect ads and blocked creators, and swipes past them. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere - matches stay on this device.
Reads on-screen text while Spotify is open to detect ads, and taps the existing Skip/Next control. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere - matches stay on this device.
Shows a floating Skip button while Podcast Addict is open. Requires a separate Notification access grant to actually perform the skip via Android's media session controls.
